title: Verify provenance
description: The provenance blob of every Verify script: which node ran which tasks, with which wasmtime and runtime module, at which degree. A record, not an identity (wall times vary); the fleet's inventory is a by-product of any run.

nodes.description: One entry per node that executed a batch, ordered by name.

node_id.description: The node's engine id (the client id on the server).

native_library.description: Where the native wasmtime came from: a path under the module, or "(load context)".

controller.description: The controller version the node ran.

runtimes.description: Runtime id → the SHA-256 the module was verified against, for every runtime the node ran.

batches.description: One entry per result batch, ordered by first task index.

degree.description: Concurrent sandboxes the batch ran at.

tasks.description: Task indices of the batch, ascending.
